fusions.name: Ramming Bale
fusions.desc: Rams a tightly wound bale of cloth into the target, dealing 12 damage, knocking it back 3 tiles and leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Scrabbling Stamp
fusions.desc: Stamps in a ring, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles, with a 20% chance per hit to leave it [Pinned] for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Guyed Stance
fusions.desc: Pegs yourself down with guy-lines, raising a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage and raises your armour by 12% for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Stiff Jerkin
fusions.desc: Conjures a stiff woollen jerkin: every hit you take is 2 lower, your armour rises by 10% and your maximum health by 8, and 10% of the damage you take goes back to whoever dealt it.
